what_it_is.prose: This card groups two flight-control-actuation and aircraft-systems OEMs. Moog Inc. (US) supplies precision primary and secondary flight-control actuation, servovalves and electrohydrostatic/electromechanical actuators; Liebherr-Aerospace (Germany) supplies flight controls, actuation, air-management and landing-gear systems. Both are embedded systems suppliers to Western airframers whose hardware may appear on platforms operated by India, but neither is documented here through a discrete, citable India defence contract. Recorded as an honest Tier C component-supplier card.
